additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480293-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / R8 170002480] OCPP Issue CRM:03289000632
additional_info.body:
Dear Gerrit Paruys,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0480293.
I checked remotely charger
MP/R8 170002480,
and I saw that the charger is offline on OCPP side because the SIM card is not detected.
The connection went offline on
2026-02-21, 13:54:33.
This could be due to one of the following reason:
SIM card expired or data expired
Issue with the SIM card, which should be replaced
Issue with the router XF4, which is unable to read SIM card anymore and should be replaced.
To assess that, it is necessary to go onsite, test the router with a different SIM card, and according to that replace the SIM card or replace the router. I will forward the ticket to the regional colleagues, so that they can coordinate the onsite activity.
In regards of the charger not shown in Sifinity Control, the customer field was not configured. I added the charger to "Sparki", and you should be able to see it now.
I will forward the ticket to the regional colleagues and they will get back to you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
